question: Yixlid Jailer says cards in graveyards lose all abilities, and Scarwood Treefolk says it enters tapped. If a Scarwood Treefolk is put onto the battlefield from a graveyard, does it still enter tapped?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the replacement effect works even though the card lost its abilities in the graveyard.
expected.answer: Yixlid Jailer says “Cards in graveyards lose all abilities.” Scarwood Treefolk says “This creature enters tapped.” A Scarwood Treefolk that’s put onto the battlefield from a graveyard enters the battlefield tapped.
